content: Verified against arXiv abstract of The Data Provenance Initiative (2310.16787): audit of 1800+ widely used fine-tuning datasets found license omission of 70%+ and license error rates of 50%+ on popular hosting sites, 'a crisis in misattribution'. Code license (MIT/Apache on a repo) does not cover data files; benchmark repos redistributing derived dataset artifacts need separate data licensing with per-dataset provenance (source, license, citation). Related frameworks: Datasheets for Datasets, Hutchinson et al. accountability survey (synthesis).
